content.short: Gamma automates concentrated liquidity management for Uniswap v3 and Algebra-style pools used by LPs on Mantle.
content.description: Gamma provides automated vaults for concentrated liquidity DEXs such as Uniswap v3, Uniswap v4, and Algebra-based markets. Its docs focus on non-custodial LP vaults, rebalancing logic, position strategies, and capital-efficient range management for users who do not want to monitor concentrated liquidity manually. The product is aimed at liquidity providers who want more systematic exposure to fee generation while accepting the risks that come with active LP strategies. On Mantle, Gamma fits as a liquidity management layer for concentrated pools where users want automated rebalancing over running positions by hand.
